summary.en-US: Group Firefox container tabs into dedicated windows while excluding detected app windows.

version.approval_notes: Source ZIP contains the full committed project, including src/, package-lock.json and build configurations. Build with Node.js 22.23.2: npm ci && npm run build. Output is build/extension/. Vite transforms TypeScript and bundles without minification. The settings UI is embedded in about:addons. HTTP/HTTPS host access is used only to read CSS display-mode and document.readyState for app-window detection; no page content or diagnostics are transmitted. Unknown windows participate in grouping. Based on Container Windows by JM; upstream MIT notice retained. Lucide icon licence included.
